title: A Goodbye Too Soon
content:
The first rays of the morning sun slowly slipped through the curtains, gently waking Sneha from her sleep.

She rubbed her eyes and quietly got down from the bed.

As she stepped into the living area, she noticed Siddu standing near the window, speaking to someone over the phone.

His voice was calm and serious.

Not wanting to disturb him, Sneha quietly returned to the room and got ready for the day.

A little while later, they met again and had breakfast together.

The cheerful atmosphere from the previous day had somehow become quieter.

After finishing breakfast, Siddu looked at Sneha.

"Sneha..."

"I'll only be able to stay with you until three o'clock this afternoon."

"After that, I have to leave for Bangalore."

Sneha looked at him in surprise.

"Bangalore?"

"What happened so suddenly?"

Siddu smiled faintly.

"I'll tell you..."

"But not now."

"You'll know in a little while."

Although she was curious, Sneha simply nodded.

Soon, they left the hotel and headed toward one of the beautiful hilltops surrounding Jammu.

The entire landscape was covered with snow.

The cool breeze brushed against their faces while the distant mountains stood proudly beneath the bright blue sky.

For the next few hours...

They laughed together.

They teased each other.

They ran through the snow like children.

They clicked photographs.

And for a little while...

It felt as though time itself had slowed down just for them.

Eventually, both of them grew tired.

They sat down on a large rock overlooking the breathtaking valley below.

The cool wind gently swept past them.

Neither of them spoke for a while.

They simply sat there, enjoying the peaceful silence and the beauty of nature.

After taking a deep breath, Sneha finally broke the silence.

"Siddu..."

"What happened?"

"Why are you suddenly going to Bangalore?"

Siddu remained quiet for a few moments.

Then he looked toward the distant mountains.

"I'm not just going to Bangalore."

He smiled faintly.

"Bangalore is only for today."

"From there..."

"I'm leaving India."

Sneha slowly turned toward him.

"What?"

"I've accepted a job offer in France."

"It's the best opportunity I've ever received."

"I got the confirmation call this morning."

He let out a slow breath.

"I was born here."

"I grew up here."

"Leaving India isn't easy."

"This country gave me everything."

"My parents..."

"My friends..."

"My memories..."

"I'll miss all of it."

"But..."

"For my future..."

"I have to take this step."

His voice carried both excitement and sadness.

Sneha stared at him in silence.

For a moment...

She couldn't process what she had just heard.

France.

That meant thousands of kilometers away.

Different time zones.

Different lives.

Different worlds.

The thought that she might not be able to see Siddu again tightened something deep inside her heart.

She forced herself to smile.

"Congratulations..."

But even she could hear how weak her voice sounded.

Behind that smile...

Her heart quietly began to break.

She turned her face toward the snow-covered mountains, pretending to admire the scenery.

In reality...

She was trying to stop the tears gathering in her eyes.

She had only just found the courage to accept that she loved him.

And now...

Before she could even tell him...

Life was preparing to take him far away.

Siddu noticed the unusual silence.

He smiled gently.

"What happened?"

"You've been unusually quiet since morning."

Sneha quickly shook her head and forced another smile.

"Nothing..."

"I'm just happy for you."

Siddu believed her without a second thought.

"Thank you," he said warmly.

"I'll miss this trip."

"I don't know when I'll get another chance to travel like this."

Sneha looked at him for a brief moment.

I'll miss you...

The words echoed inside her heart.

But they never reached her lips.

Instead...

She simply smiled.

And as the cold mountain breeze swept across the valley...

It carried away the words that remained trapped inside her heart.

"I love you, Siddu."
